inputs.text: You know the organizers are out here claiming eight million people hit these No Kings protests across all 50 states at over 3,300 events, supposedly to go after Trump. This has every mark of hidden elites coordinating the whole thing to manufacture a fake wave of opposition and keep him in check. AFP is pushing the line, but no official count from the authorities because they don't want the real picture out. They even admit it was about one million more participants and 600 more events than last October, which just shows how the machine is ramping up the numbers to twist the narrative and hide who's really pulling the strings.

output.main_topic: Conspiratorial skepticism about reported attendance at No Kings protests
subtopics: Reported protest attendance and event counts
Claims of media and authority concealment
